items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al Kohn would grab him and he’d never miss a beat.

ctx.x: And they would always catch it and Mousie would hit it with a cymbal crash or something. Apparently they never, seldom, if ever missed. Whoever the bartender was was good at catching the shot glasses.
Yeah, it was a whole vaudeville act. More seriously was when Zoot was playing and starting to fall backwards off the stand and Al Kohn would grab him and he’d never miss a beat.
The Half Note was a strange . . . it was a wonderful club but it was a strange set up.
